info.title: Ghostmaxxing Backend API
info.summary: HTTP API, federation, moderation, feed, and diagnostic surfaces for the Ghostmaxxing backend.
info.description: This specification is derived from the Express routes in server.js and routes/*.js. ActivityPub and WebFinger payloads are JSON-LD/JRD surfaces generated through Fedify, so those schemas intentionally allow extension fields.

get.summary: Serve the diagnostic lab page from the /lab mount

200.description: Server health and enabled actor/filter summary.

200.description: OpenAPI 3.1 JSON specification for this backend.

get.summary: Return the raw local follower store

200.description: Follower rows keyed by local actor handle.

post.summary: Submit a public upload for moderation
post.description: Receives either a video upload or clipboard PNG. The file field is named `video` for both kinds.
